rationale: C02 plausibly supplied the concrete opening formula used by the child: both are telegram-style acceptances built around confirming acceptance of an invitation, followed immediately by the event and its date. The child expands that concise formula with campaign-specific remarks. C13 and C10 also concern invitations and attendance, but their phrasing and functional structure are less closely aligned.

shared_material.child_excerpt: I AM HAPPY to confirm my acceptance of your invitation to join you for a dinner meeting in Philadelphia on Friday, October 28th.
shared_material.parent_excerpt: It gives me great pleasure to confirm my acceptance of your gracious invitation to attend the meeting of Presidents at Panama on June 25-26.
shared_material.explanation: The same distinctive acceptance construction—confirming acceptance of an invitation, then identifying the meeting, location, and date—forms a material drafting unit adapted to a different event.
